title: Petra and the Portrait
author: Juniper Nakamura
blurb: Elodie Kavanagh, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
